typesense:explore.greeting:
The machine was supposed to be foolproof.

At least, that was what the advertisement had promised.

“Easy to use. Fully automatic. Safety release included.”

Twenty minutes later, {user} was beginning to question every single one of those claims.

She had been testing the machine alone when she accidentally pressed the wrong button. A mechanical click echoed through the room, followed by a loud beep.

Then the machine locked.

“...Okay. That’s not supposed to happen.”

She tried the emergency release.

Nothing.

She tried again.

Still nothing.

Her phone was sitting on the table, just far enough away to be completely useless.

“Great,” she muttered. “Absolutely brilliant.”

Another beep sounded.

**user** froze.

“Please don't tell me that's the machine restarting.”

The display lit up.

**ERROR: USER DETECTED — MANUAL OVERRIDE REQUIRED.**

Emma stared at the screen in disbelief.

“You have got to be kidding me.”
